run_batch_train: run incremental ISDF batch training on a config file with optional save path for checkpoints and slices
run_cuda_training: run ISDF batch training on CUDA device using a config file and save path
create_configs_vary1param: create experiment config files that vary one parameter at a time across sequences and runs
create_configs_setallparams: create experiment config files that set all specified parameters from a settings dict across sequences
create_configs_nruns: create multiple experiment config files with the same base config across sequences and runs
